outputs.serial_0_trigger: elapsedAccumMs >= 0 and ((io_0 > lightThreshold) or (io_1 > tempThreshold) or true)

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个实验数据监视系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、LM35（A1）和串口。系统每秒通过串口输出一次光照值和温度值；如果任一值超过设定阈值，则额外输出 WARNING，并点亮 D13 LED。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: drive io_0 and io_1 to values not exceeding thresholds; advance io_3 with cumulative elapsed time spanning >=1000ms for one model tick
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger asserts once for the once-per-second report step; serial_0_value_0 equals latest io_0; serial_0_value_1 equals latest io_1; io_2 remains false; serial_1_trigger remains false
